text: With eccentricity widened to [0, 0.9], does the accel_step random-control R2 fall well below its usual 0.71-0.76 (as it fell to 0.35-0.38 with e in [0, 0.8])? If so, the high control at e <= 0.5 comes from r tracking the input-visible orbit scale a, and headroom-normalized margins should be reported for low-e runs.
